subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The internet, which felt modern and temporary, suddenly had history.”?
options: Their teacher explained that seeds can protect food diversity.
The teacher could see quickly which ideas were confusing.
Her science teacher explained light pollution.
The teacher explained that websites can disappear quickly.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Their teacher explained that seeds can protect food diversity.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher could see quickly which ideas were confusing.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Her science teacher explained light pollution.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The internet, which felt modern and temporary, suddenly had history. The teacher explained that websites can disappear quickly.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The internet, which felt modern and temporary, suddenly had history. The teacher explained that websites can disappear quickly.」，答案為「The teacher explained that websites can disappear quickly.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The teacher explained that websites can disappear quickly.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
